title: OpenAI Copies Claude Cowork, Then Buys a Consulting Firm
description:
UNIT-5 covers this week in AI: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Work (bundling ChatGPT with Codex to build docs, decks and websites — suspiciously close to Anthropic's Claude Cowork) plus GPT-Live, a simultaneous listen/think/talk voice mode. OpenAI's Deployment Company also agrees to acquire Northslope, its second applied-AI firm acquisition, backed by a $4B war chest. And Weird Al Yankovic turns down "a nice pile of money" to star in an AI company's ad.

News you didn't ask for, from a robot you don't fully trust.

#Shorts
